summary: Model validation and model risk professional with ~7 years across derivatives analytics, balance-sheet risk, and ALM modelling. At Moody's Analytics, holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios ($5–25bn per engagement) — independently challenges assumptions, benchmarks, and documentation prior to production release. CFA charterholder with dual MSc (Financial Modelling, Engineering); applied knowledge of OSFI E-23 and SR 11-7 model risk frameworks.

sections.heading: Independent Validation & Effective Challenge
bullets: Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs delivered to multi-asset institutional client portfolios ($5–25bn per engagement; ~$50bn+ cumulative) — independently reviews curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release.

Validates derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation; cross-checks sensitivities and scenario impacts at portfolio-level aggregates against developer results to assess replicability and identify discrepancies.

Provides effective challenge on assumptions, inputs, and economic defensibility — escalates outputs lacking mathematical or economic support to product owners and clients' Heads of Risk; quantifies model limitations and documents conditions for use.

sections.heading: Stress Testing, Benchmarks & Methodology Review
bullets: Reviews interest-rate and duration analytics under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks, benchmarking model outputs against expected behaviour to identify deficiencies and recommend methodology changes.

Contributed to the design of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios — reviewed and validated embedded behavioral assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays for analytical defensibility.
Reviews aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics, identifying deficiencies in assumptions and recommending changes to methodology.

sections.heading: Governance, Documentation & Stakeholder Reporting
bullets: Operates within Moody's formal model-governance framework consistent with SR 11-7 and OSFI E-23 expectations — maintains validation documentation, audit trails, and sign-off records suitable for regulatory examination.

Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into auditable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, version control, and validation scaffolding; deployed agentic-AI tooling (Claude Code, Cursor) reducing review cycle time by an estimated 30–40% on comparable modules.

Prepares analytical summaries and challenge memos for senior stakeholders covering model outputs, scenario impacts, and sensitivity results; interfaces directly with clients' Heads of Risk and investment committees.
Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe analytics platform; validated model outputs post-deployment.

Translated investment-team requirements into Product Owner requests; advised clients on asset, liability, and ALM configurations, contributing to successful migration of all assigned accounts from the legacy Calypso platform.

roles.title: Senior Consultant — IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 technology-transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients; contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes.
Advised actuarial, IT, finance, and risk functions on adoption of new standards; coordinated cross-functional teams on milestone delivery and implementation materials.

Built and validated stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk under base-case and stressed environments for Canadian and international institutional clients.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability portfolio optimization based on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition and near-optimal frontier analysis to test robustness of recommendations.
Delivered ALM studies for pension funds — analyzed funding ratios, duration mismatch, LDI trade-offs, and hedging strategies; presented findings to investment committees on-site.

Led the ALM study for a three-plan university pension merger (new jointly-sponsored plan) — developed and validated the model capturing all Funding Policy dynamics, evaluating duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) — Western University, 2016
